original_ai_output.title_zh: 达美航空与BCI合作十年，在加纳开展乳腺癌教育覆盖16.6万人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 达美航空与Breast Care International（BCI）长达十年的合作在加纳通过乳腺癌教育覆盖超过16.6万人，筛查超过2.25万人，发现近2100例疑似病例。两家机构在阿散蒂地区Mampong举行的2026年BCI Walk for the Cure活动上纪念合作十周年时公布了上述数据。该项目还通过有针对性的农村筛查举措覆盖了超过7.01万名女性。

key_facts.fact: 达美航空与BCI合作十年在加纳通过乳腺癌教育覆盖超过16.6万人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A decade-long partnership between Delta Air Lines and Breast Care International (BCI) has reached more than 166,000 people with breast cancer education in Ghana

key_facts.fact: 筛查超过2.25万人，发现近2100例疑似病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with over 22,500 people screened and nearly 2,100 suspected cases identified

key_facts.fact: 两家机构在阿散蒂地区Mampong举行的2026年BCI Walk for the Cure活动上纪念合作十周年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The figures were highlighted as the two organisations marked 10 years of collaboration at the 2026 BCI Walk for the Cure in Mampong, in the Ashanti Region

key_facts.fact: 项目通过农村筛查举措覆盖超过7.01万名女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The programme has also reached more than 70,100 women through targeted rural screening initiatives
